translationRepairs: On renyang in the third month Grand Guardian Zonghan, Grand Preceptor Zongpan, and Grand Tutor Zonggan jointly headed the Three Departments.
On renwu in the third month Grand Guardian Zonghan, Grand Preceptor Zongpan, and Grand Tutor Zonggan jointly headed the Three Departments.

On renwu in the third month, Grand Guardian Zonghan, Grand Preceptor Zongpan, and Grand Tutor Zonggan all took charge of the Three Departments.

Han Fang of the Hanlin Academy answered: “That was because Taizong questioned them with a gentle face, and Fang Xuanling and Du Rumi poured out loyal counsel.
Han Fang of the Hanlin Academy answered: “That was because Taizong questioned them with a gentle face, and Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui poured out loyal counsel.
杜 here abbreviates the Tang minister Du Ruhui (杜如晦), paired with Fang Xuanling; Du Rumi is a misspelling.
On renyang the morning audience was held in the Tianyuan Hall.
On renwu the morning audience was held in the Tianyuan Hall.
壬午 is the cyclical day renwu; renyang is not a valid sexagenary term.
On yiyou Coastal King Yelu Yanxi was redesignated prince of Yu, Deposed Duke Zhao Ji became duke of Tianwater commandery, and Twice-Deposed Marquis Zhao Huan became duke of Tianwater district.
On yiyou Coastal King Yelu Yanxi was redesignated prince of Yu, Duke of Depravity Zhao Ji became prince of Tianshui commandery, and Twice-Deposed Marquis Zhao Huan became duke of Tianwater district.
天水郡王 is a commandery prince of Tianshui, not a duke; 昏德公 is rendered Duke of Depravity elsewhere in the chapter.
The former Song empress dowager Lady Wei, the former consort Lady Xing, Duke of Tianwater commandery Zhao Ji and Lady Zheng, and the duke’s coffin were escorted south to Jiangnan.
The Song ruler’s mother Lady Wei was sent back to Jiangnan, together with the coffins of his late wife Lady Xing, the Prince of Tianshui, and the prince’s wife Lady Zheng.
The source returns Lady Wei alive and the coffins (喪) of Lady Xing, the Prince of Tianshui and Lady Zheng; 天水郡王 is a commandery prince, and no coffin of a separate duke is mentioned.
In the eleventh month, on jiayin, Grand Councilor and Prince of Qishui Ang died and was posthumously made Prince of Yan.
In the eleventh month, on jiayin, Grand Councilor and Prince of Qishui Ang died and was posthumously made Prince of Yun.
鄆王 is Prince of Yun, not Yan.
In the fifth month, on renshen, King Kojong of Goryeo died.
In the fifth month, on renshen, Wang Kai, king of Goryeo died.
高麗王楷 is Wang Kai (Injong); Kojong is a different king.

In the sixth month, on dingyou, he executed Henghai Army commissioner Tian Juan, Left Department director Xi Yi, Hanlin awaiting appointment Xing Juzhan, and Wang Zhi, Gao Fengting, Wang Xiao, Zhao Yixing, Gong Yijian, and others.

In the sixth month, on yisi, Yuwen Xu and Gao Shitan were put to death.
In the sixth month, on yisi, Yuwen Xuzhong and Gao Shitan were put to death.
宇文虛中 is Yuwen Xuzhong; the name was truncated.

Mobile secretariat right grand councilor Liu Ke and right vice director Xiao Zhonggong were named grand councilors; Li Degu became right vice director of the Department of State Affairs; and Secretariat director Xiao Zi became vice grand councilor.

In the second month, on jiayin, Metropolitan Herd director Tangguo Bian was again made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and Left Vice Director Bingde became grand councilor of the mobile secretariat.

會甯牧 is the governor of Huining; 稟 is Bing, not Bingde.

On gengxu Zongxian was again made grand guardian while retaining the posts of left chief councilor and left vice commander-in-chief.
